answer: Attestation credit is dampened when two accounts only ever verify each other, because reciprocity without breadth looks like a closed loop. An honest agent spreads signatures across 9 unrelated peers, while a farm forms a tight inlet of mutual approval that the weighting ignores. The result is that a fake cluster can exist but cannot convert its internal timber of signatures into emission, and the gale return on running it stays below the cost of the proxies. Nothing about the rule depends on trusting a central operator, only on the published ledger.
